title: PROPOSAL (awaiting OWNER authorization): P5-M06 mail transport as an injected MailTransport contract, no bundled SMTP client dependency
problem: P5-M06 (email-based password recovery) is blocked on 'a mail-transport architecture decision (a dependency, or an injected transport contract); Node has no built-in SMTP'. DEC-0026 recorded the Manager's preferred answer as if the OWNER had decided it, and was revoked (INVALID_AUTHORITY) per REQ-0002 section 15: architecture choices need explicit OWNER authority. This record is the properly-scoped replacement: a MANAGER PROPOSAL with evidence and options, in state PROPOSED. It decides nothing until the OWNER authorizes or rejects it.

options.summary: Manager-recommended: define MailTransport as an injected host contract in the repo's standard split (pure values in, frozen values out; the host does the IO). The product ships no SMTP client and no mail-provider SDK. P5-M06 sends recovery mail by calling the injected transport; tests use a recording fake transport; operators wire SMTP or provider-API adapters outside the product bundle.
Bundle a mature SMTP client dependency and own the SMTP conversation, TLS, auth and retry inside the product.
Bundle one mail provider's HTTP SDK and send mail through that provider's API.

rationale: selectedOption records the Manager's RECOMMENDED option on this PROPOSAL; it is NOT a decision. decidedBy is UNDECIDED and state is PROPOSED: only the OWNER may accept or change the selection when authorizing this record. The Manager's recommendation is option A, for these reasons, offered as evidence for the owner's choice: (1) every contract in the codebase uses the same split - pure values in, frozen values out, the host does the IO - and mail transport is host IO; (2) the repo is deliberately dependency-averse (the catalog fetcher exists to avoid a 70 MB dependency tree the runtime never executes), and an SMTP client would add TLS, auth and retry machinery the product would then own; (3) option C is the same IO problem with vendor lock-in; (4) an injected transport is fully testable in CI via a recording fake transport; (5) operators keep freedom to run SMTP, a provider API, or a corporate relay without a product release. Scope wall: this proposal covers the transport question only; the recovery flow remains P5-M06 delivery work and must not be started while the slice is blocked and unauthorized (REQ-0002 sections 15, 19, 20).

reason.summary: Promoted PROPOSED -> ACTIVE on explicit owner direction in master prompt REQ-0005 (2026-09-27), authorized item 8: P5-M06 password recovery with a provider-neutral injected mail transport contract, without vendor lock-in and without selecting an external provider as a mandatory dependency. That instruction selects option A (injected transport) as the architecture; option B (external SMTP provider) remains an optional injectable binding, never a mandatory dependency.
